phenotype_reported: Bone mineral density (source GWAS GCST005348: Total body bone mineral density)
summary: PGS005206 (BMD_PRS, 81 variants, GRCh38 harmonized scoring file matching its approved SHA-256 pin) was applied with the Stage 2 scorer to a synthetic effect-allele dosage file for 20 individuals (sha256 ac0ea0601f4750b69b902044a63fd7799a1de97006a902f08d625de69b9f5ffd, matching the authorized synthetic file). All 20 individuals were scored with QC status PASS (0 PARTIAL, 0 LOW_COVERAGE, 0 NO_DATA), with variant coverage of 1.0 and no effect-allele mismatches in the 81 checked variants. The score's phenotype is bone mineral density, and the linked source GWAS (GCST005348) is total body bone mineral density; the score's own PGS Catalog trait fields name no skeletal site. The scores were recomputed after an earlier scores file was found altered after writing. The input data are synthetic. The target data contain no phenotypes or ancestry, so predictive validity and transferability could not be measured. The only recorded evaluation is in European children (n=3470, Generation R). In the scoring file, 24 variants have an ambiguous other allele and 5 are palindromic. The original genome build is not reported, the derivation of the 81 weights is unverified, and allele agreement does not test strand harmonization of real genotypes. Per-individual scores are in artifacts/prs_scores_2.csv. No percentiles, risk categories or clinical interpretation are provided.
